offers_products.reason: Main offering is unit rental; any locks or boxes sold are incidental.

offers_services.reason: Rents self-storage units (REIT leasing) and manages facilities for others; services-type real estate offering.

sells_to_consumers.reason: Personal, student, military and vehicle storage for individuals and households are core.

sells_to_organizations.reason: Offers business and commercial storage for inventory, documents and equipment, though consumers likely dominate.

recurring_revenue.reason: Month-to-month storage unit rentals from tenants who stay on an ongoing basis.

cyclical_demand.reason: Storage rent is a small recurring cost tied to life events; customers rarely drop it quickly in downturns.

big_ticket.reason: Customers pay small, frequent monthly rent for storage units.

people_delivered.reason: Customers pay for storage space in owned facilities, not staff time and skill.

large_customers.reason: Main customers are individuals and households, plus small businesses renting units.

asset_heavy.reason: Owns, develops and operates about 475 self-storage properties; growth requires acquiring and building facilities, like a REIT.

notes: Business is a self-storage REIT; also has a third-party management and tenant insurance side. Answers rely on the website text and general knowledge.
